summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K to disclose that independent director Mr. Radhakrishnan Nair retired on May 1, 2026, upon completion of his second term. This is a routine retirement notice, not a forced or abrupt departure. The filing is an ordinary disclosure under Indian listing regulations and contains no merger, acquisition, strategic review, or special situation event. The registrant is the filer, reporting a standard director term expiry.
